usd_balance.label: Existing USD balance, no trade conversion

note: Nine alternative fictional accounts; never add balances or results. Telegram acknowledgement is not a user read receipt. Daily loss uses realized net trading P/L plus reserved risk; a EUR50 realized loss latches a halt until the next Dublin date. Gap losses can exceed planned limits. Missing exits or open quote gaps over 60 seconds retain exposure and block new entries. Costs, slippage, frozen FX conversion and quote liquidity are assumptions; AI costs are excluded. No marked-to-market equity. Only notified approved USD-stock setups are represented; upstream rejections and missing acknowledgement clocks are absent. Session permission uses the original approved plan window, not a new halt/exchange check. No real orders.
